```{python}
#| label: setup
from pathlib import Path
import json
import pandas as pd
import plotly.graph_objects as go
import plotly.io as pio

pio.templates.default = "plotly_dark"

ROOT = Path("..")
if not (ROOT / "bench-results").exists():
    ROOT = Path(".")

FP8_DIR = ROOT / "bench-results" / "gemma4-fp8-1gpu-15k-900"
NVFP4_DIR = ROOT / "bench-results" / "gemma4-nvfp4-1gpu-15k-900"
ISL, OSL = 15000, 900


def load_tiers(data_dir: Path, label: str) -> pd.DataFrame:
    rows = []
    if not data_dir.exists():
        return pd.DataFrame()
    for path in sorted(data_dir.glob("conc-*.json"), key=lambda p: int(p.stem.split("-")[1])):
        c = int(path.stem.split("-")[1])
        d = json.loads(path.read_text())
        ttft = d.get("mean_ttft_ms")
        tpot = d.get("mean_tpot_ms")
        out_len = int(d.get("output_len") or OSL)
        e2el = d.get("mean_e2el_ms")
        if e2el is None and ttft is not None and tpot is not None:
            e2el = float(ttft) + float(tpot) * max(out_len - 1, 0)
        rows.append(
            {
                "label": label,
                "C": c,
                "completed": d.get("completed"),
                "failed": d.get("failed"),
                "out_tps": d.get("output_throughput"),
                "req_tps": d.get("request_throughput"),
                "ttft_ms": ttft,
                "tpot_ms": tpot,
                "e2el_s": (e2el / 1000.0) if e2el is not None else None,
            }
        )
    return pd.DataFrame(rows).sort_values("C") if rows else pd.DataFrame()


FP8 = load_tiers(FP8_DIR, "FP8-dynamic")
NV = load_tiers(NVFP4_DIR, "NVFP4")
ALL = pd.concat([FP8, NV], ignore_index=True) if (not FP8.empty or not NV.empty) else pd.DataFrame()

fp8_seed = (FP8_DIR / "seed.txt").read_text().strip() if (FP8_DIR / "seed.txt").exists() else "—"
nv_seed = (NVFP4_DIR / "seed.txt").read_text().strip() if (NVFP4_DIR / "seed.txt").exists() else "—"
```

# Goal

Compare [`RedHatAI/gemma-4-26B-A4B-it-FP8-dynamic`](https://huggingface.co/RedHatAI/gemma-4-26B-A4B-it-FP8-dynamic) vs [`RedHatAI/gemma-4-26B-A4B-it-NVFP4`](https://huggingface.co/RedHatAI/gemma-4-26B-A4B-it-NVFP4) on **1×H200**, text-only, concurrency **1…10**, **ISL/OSL = 15000/900**.

Serve knobs matched where possible: TP=1, `--gpu-memory-utilization 0.95`, `--kv-cache-dtype fp8`, `--block-size 32`, chunked prefill + prefix caching, gemma4 tool/reasoning parsers, `--limit-mm-per-prompt '{"image":0,"audio":0}'`.

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
print(
    f"FP8 tiers: **{len(FP8)}**/10 (seed `{fp8_seed}`) · "
    f"NVFP4 tiers: **{len(NV)}**/10 (seed `{nv_seed}`)"
)
```

# Side-by-side summary

```{python}
#| label: tbl-compare
#| tbl-cap: "FP8 vs NVFP4 at each concurrency. E2E ≈ TTFT + TPOT × (OSL − 1)."
#| output: asis

if FP8.empty and NV.empty:
    print("_No results yet._")
else:
    fp8_m = FP8.set_index("C") if not FP8.empty else pd.DataFrame()
    nv_m = NV.set_index("C") if not NV.empty else pd.DataFrame()
    cs = sorted(set(fp8_m.index.tolist()) | set(nv_m.index.tolist()))
    lines = [
        "",
        "| C | FP8 tok/s | NVFP4 tok/s | Δ tok/s | FP8 TTFT | NVFP4 TTFT | FP8 TPOT | NVFP4 TPOT | FP8 E2E s | NVFP4 E2E s |",
        "|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|",
    ]
    for c in cs:
        def cell(df, col, fmt):
            if df.empty or c not in df.index or pd.isna(df.loc[c, col]):
                return "—"
            return fmt.format(df.loc[c, col])

        f_out = cell(fp8_m, "out_tps", "{:.1f}")
        n_out = cell(nv_m, "out_tps", "{:.1f}")
        if f_out != "—" and n_out != "—":
            delta = f"{float(n_out) - float(f_out):+.1f}"
        else:
            delta = "—"
        lines.append(
            f"| {c} | {f_out} | {n_out} | {delta} "
            f"| {cell(fp8_m, 'ttft_ms', '{:.1f}')} | {cell(nv_m, 'ttft_ms', '{:.1f}')} "
            f"| {cell(fp8_m, 'tpot_ms', '{:.2f}')} | {cell(nv_m, 'tpot_ms', '{:.2f}')} "
            f"| {cell(fp8_m, 'e2el_s', '{:.2f}')} | {cell(nv_m, 'e2el_s', '{:.2f}')} |"
        )
    lines.append("")
    print("\n".join(lines))
```

```{python}
#| label: fig-throughput
#| fig-cap: "Output token throughput vs concurrency."

if not ALL.empty:
    fig = go.Figure()
    for label, color in (("FP8-dynamic", "#5B8FF9"), ("NVFP4", "#5AD8A6")):
        sub = ALL[ALL["label"] == label]
        if sub.empty:
            continue
        fig.add_trace(
            go.Scatter(
                x=sub["C"], y=sub["out_tps"], mode="lines+markers",
                name=label, line=dict(color=color),
            )
        )
    fig.update_layout(
        xaxis_title="Concurrency",
        yaxis_title="Output tokens/sec",
        height=420,
        legend=dict(orientation="h", y=1.12),
    )
    fig.update_xaxes(tickvals=list(range(1, 11)), dtick=1)
    fig.show()
```
